tasks.title: Probe docs explain buffer loss, reloads, token rotation and request side effects

P7/F5: reviewer verifies State says no disk state and buffered results are lost on stop, restart or crash, shutdown logs their count, and nothing replays after restart; consistent with Result buffer and src/buffer.ts:close. R5 links api changing-checks and says API hot reload then probe refresh within PULSE_CHECKS_RELOAD_MS. R6 rotates through POST /admin/tokens/<id>/rotate, installs secret and restarts probe within 10-minute overlap, links api token-rotation, and says API token-file edits after import do nothing; sources api src/token-routes.ts, src/token-import.ts and api docs/operation.md#token-rotation. Retain restart for PULSE_PROBE_TOKEN, PULSE_PROBE_TOKEN_FILE and PULSE_LOCATION.

P8/W2: reviewer verifies Retries distinguishes checked request side effects from idempotent POST /results and at-least-once notify; non-GET/HEAD HTTP sends once per interval per location, configured method decides before redirects, and recommends side-effect-free endpoints. Keep existing HTTP GET/HEAD, TCP/DNS/domain retries and TLS exception; source src/check.ts:isRetryable and run loop. R8 states startup fetch plus reload. R7 compares token location through GET /admin/tokens (not imported file); R5 removes restart advice from troubleshooting, including the invalid-check action, and describes API reload followed by probe refresh; sources api src/start.ts, src/token-routes.ts and probe Checks reload.

Reviewer opens every added/changed link and verifies existing destination files/headings, including api operation.md#changing-checks, operation.md#token-rotation and rest-api.md#tokens; no heading needed by another document is renamed.

PR body contains 6 evidence rows for F5, R5-R8 and W2 with item, file/section, old text or missing, new statement, source file/symbol and checked commit; cites src/buffer.ts, src/check.ts:isRetryable and api src/token-routes.ts. Includes N10-N16 outputs, P7-P8/source/link review, bun run check result and Markdown-only file list.
